req.title: Honour Accept: application/json
req.statement: The system shall respect an Accept: application/json request header by serialising responses as JSON.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that when a client sends Accept: application/json, the server must respond with JSON-serialised content. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — standard GET /get with Accept: application/json yields 200 and valid JSON with correct Content-Type; (2) positive EP — POST /post with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (3) positive EP — /headers endpoint with Accept: application/json; (4) negative NEG — endpoint that does not produce JSON (/status/200) still returns 2xx but we verify the Accept header is echoed correctly; (5) boundary BVA — Accept header with quality values (application/json;q=1.0) still honoured; (6) DT — multiple endpoints (PUT, PATCH, DELETE) with Accept: application/json all return JSON; (7) NEG — verifying Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' not a superset string mismatch. Each test asserts exact status codes, exact Content-Type values, and exact JSON structure keys to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /get with Accept: application/json header
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: Accept: application/json must yield JSON response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_body
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
POST /post endpoint is available

trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: POST endpoint must serialise response as JSON when Accept: application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_body():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post(
        '/post',
        data={'key': 'value'},
        headers={'Accept': 'application/json'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in body
    assert body['form'] == {'key': 'value'}

test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_body()

tests.name: test_put_patch_delete_with_accept_json_all_return_json
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put, PATCH /patch, DELETE /delete endpoints are available
expected: All JSON bodies contain keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: All HTTP method endpoints must honour Accept: application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_put_patch_delete_with_accept_json_all_return_json():
    client = app.test_client()
    expected_keys = ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json')
    for method, path in [('PUT', '/put'), ('PATCH', '/patch'), ('DELETE', '/delete')]:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} returned {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert 'application/json' in ct, f'{method} Content-Type was {ct}'
        body = json.loads(r.data)
        for key in expected_keys:
            assert key in body, f'{method} body missing key {key}'

test_put_patch_delete_with_accept_json_all_return_json()

tests.name: test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint is available
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: Response must be serialised as JSON, not as HTML or plain text
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    assert 'text/html' not in ct
    assert 'text/plain' not in ct
    # Verify body is parseable JSON (not HTML markup)
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    # Ensure no HTML tags leaked into response
    raw = r.data.decode('utf-8')
    assert '<html' not in raw.lower()
    assert '</html>' not in raw.lower()

test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with valid Basic auth credentials and Accept: application/json
expected: JSON body has authenticated == True (boolean, not string)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: /basic-auth endpoint must return JSON when Accept: application/json and auth succeeds
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
import base64

def test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body.get('authenticated') is True
    assert body.get('user') == 'user'

test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_failure_with_accept_json_returns_401_not_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with WRONG credentials and Accept: application/json
expected: Response is NOT a successful JSON body with authenticated=True
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error (wrong credentials)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
import base64

def test_basic_auth_failure_with_accept_json_returns_401_not_200():
    client = app.test_client()
    bad_creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:wrongpassword').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': f'Basic {bad_creds}'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert r.status_code != 200
    # Must NOT return authenticated=True
    try:
        body = json.loads(r.data)
        assert body.get('authenticated') is not True
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        pass  # Non-JSON 401 body is acceptable

test_basic_auth_failure_with_accept_json_returns_401_not_200()

tests.name: test_get_with_accept_json_response_body_is_not_empty_and_has_exact_top_level_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /get with Accept: application/json and a query parameter
expected: JSON body has exactly the keys: url, args, headers, origin (no more, no fewer)
args dict contains the sent query parameter with exact value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: JSON payload must contain exactly the documented fields — catches mutations that add/remove keys or change values
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_with_accept_json_response_body_is_not_empty_and_has_exact_top_level_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert len(body['url']) > 0

test_get_with_accept_json_response_body_is_not_empty_and_has_exact_top_level_keys()
